description:
One call on the consignment object for the ADR picture of a road load: the 1.1.3.6 small-load verdict, the limited / excepted quantity check of each line, the tunnel restriction code of the whole load against the tunnels on the route, each line's transport-document entry, mixed loading (7.5.2, with the foodstuffs precautions of 7.5.4), and the vehicle side — orange-coloured plates and placards (5.3), the documents, fire extinguishers and equipment on the transport unit (8.1), and driver training (8.2); and the UN packaging mark of each line (6.1.3.1). The rules are page-cited to the free UNECE ADR 2025 publication. For the 1.1.3.6 check alone use adr_exemption_calculator; LQ / EQ alone adr_lq_eq_check; a row's columns adr_lookup.

Send lines[] (un_number, quantity {value, unit, basis} and, where they apply, packing_group / variant_index, packages with un_mark, inner_packaging) and optionally journey, vehicle and crew; journey.date is the default as_of, and an as_of that contradicts it is refused. A check whose input is not sent is conditional, the input named in missing_inputs — never assumed. status is pass | fail | conditional | insufficient_data; a relief that does not apply is not_applicable, not fail. edition ("2025" | "2027") and as_of choose the ADR edition; neither sent, ADR 2025 until 2027-01-01. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets. Not checked: whether the packaging kind is one the packing instruction allows, IBC / large-packaging marks, the vehicle approval of Part 9, the elevated temperature mark (5.3.3), handling and stowage (7.5.7). Not legal advice, verify against the current UNECE ADR text.

as_of.description: The date the answer is for, YYYY-MM-DD (default today, UTC).

crew.description: The crew, for the driver-training and document checks. Facts only — no name.

adr_training_certificate.description: The driver holds the ADR 8.2.1 training certificate.

awareness_training_1_3.description: The driver is trained according to Chapter 1.3 (8.2.3).

photo_identification.description: Each crew member carries identification with a photograph (8.1.2.1 (d)).

edition.description: ADR edition; wins over as_of. Omitted: as_of picks it.

date.description: Date of carriage, YYYY-MM-DD — the default as_of.

tunnels_on_route.description: ADR tunnel categories on the route (A–E).

lines.description: The lines of the load (1–50). Required.

description.description: What the line is, at most 200 characters.

icao_limited_quantity.description: ID-prefixed line only: the packages are ICAO Technical Instructions limited quantities (3.4.8 mark / 3.4.10).

inner_packaging.description: The inner packaging, for the limited / excepted quantity check.

per_outer.description: Inner packagings in one outer packaging (default 1) — the excepted-quantity outer limit.

quantity.description: The quantity in ONE inner packaging.

regime.description: The exemption the line is meant to use (a stated regime that is missed fails); omitted, both are checked and a line that fits neither is not_applicable.

packages.description: The pieces; a line in packages is "other carriage" for the ADR 8.6.4 tunnel table.

un_mark.description: The UN packaging mark as printed (ADR 6.1.3.1), e.g. "UN 4G/Y145/S/02/NL/VL823".

packing_group.description: Packing group, to pin one ADR Table A row of a multi-row UN.

basis.description: "net" or "gross"; a gross mass on a mass-counted row is an upper bound.

unit.description: L or kg, checked against the dimension ADR 1.1.3.6.3 counts.

value.description: The dangerous-goods quantity for the whole line, all packages together; 0 = not carried.

un_number.description: UN number ("1203", "UN1203") or ID-prefixed air-only number ("ID 8000"); a line without one is not a dangerous-goods line.

variant_index.description: ADR Table A variant index (as adr_lookup returns it), to pin one row.

options.description: The consignment object's options; not read by this check.

equipment_8_1_5.description: The ADR 8.1.5 items on board; an item not listed is read as not on board.

fire_extinguishers_kg.description: Each portable fire extinguisher on board, kg (ADR 8.1.4).

foodstuffs_carried.description: Foodstuffs or animal feeds are carried in the same vehicle or container (ADR 7.5.4).

instructions_in_writing.description: The ADR 5.4.3 instructions in writing are in the cab.

max_mass_t.description: The transport unit's maximum permissible mass, tonnes.

orange_plates_displayed.description: The two orange-coloured plates are displayed.

placards_displayed.description: The placards ADR 5.3.1.5 requires are displayed.

name: adr_consignment_check
title: ADR Consignment Check
